# Plan: ISSUE-520

Remove the unused changed-package pre-run representation and selection code while preserving configured required checks, diagnostics, cache behavior, and ordinary report/JSON output. Dimensions are approved: small, known, standard; compact profile. This fits the 16-hour claim budget (estimated implementation and focused verification: 1–2 hours).

## What we know

- `CheckRunOutcome` still declares the three unused fields at `internal/validation/validator.go:85–91`; repository search found readers and test literals, but no production writer enabling them.
- Dead selection code is confined to `internal/validation/go_fastpass.go:17–21,78–85,97–150,168–221`. This file also contains live helpers and must remain.
- Readers also exist in duration history (`internal/validation/build_cache.go:259,269`), repair (`internal/validation/repair.go:199`), report recording/timing metadata (`internal/validation/validator.go:415,426,537`), and CLI rendering/filtering (`internal/cli/validate.go:240`, `internal/cli/work_validation.go:31`).
- Existing `internal/cli/go_fastpass_test.go:16` exercises issue work, validate, and submit; all expect no selected-package invocation. Its comment and `fast` column describe obsolete behavior.
- Keep JSON capture: `internal/validation/go_fastpass.go:244` uses `parseGoTestAll`; repair uses `boundedBuffer`, `validImportPath`, and `goIgnoredDir` (`repair.go:232,432,547`). Shared fixture `setupGoFastPassRepo` has callers in repair_test.go, validator_test.go, and go_test_cache_test.go; preserve its name and availability.
- Source search found no corresponding symbol/file references in README.md, docs/, or internal/harness. No documentation/template update is needed.

## What we're assuming

The provided read-only source snapshot represents the approved base. Git metadata is unavailable (`git rev-parse HEAD` fails); the developer must compare the checkout/base before editing. No new production file is proposed. The only rename destination, `internal/cli/required_checks_test.go`, is absent in this snapshot; confirm absence at the approved base before the rename.

## Open questions

No blocking design questions. Build, vet, and focused execution will establish dependency completeness after removal. Tests use trusted-local/mock offline fixtures; configured production execution is native isolation with Codex on Linux (`.swarm/config.yaml:9–12,48–53`). This refactor changes shared bookkeeping, not execution paths or harness capabilities. OCI and other OS qualification are outside scope; preserve their existing paths.

## Architectural context

The authoritative runner already executes required checks directly. Remove the unreachable representation and readers without restructuring scheduling, isolation, repair attribution, timeout limits, trusted policy loading, cache keys, or report schemas beyond deleting fields already omitted at their zero values.

## Implementation sequence

1. Modify `internal/validation/go_fastpass.go`: delete maxFastPass constants, fastPassFits, goPackage, parseGoList, and affectedPackages; remove only imports made unused. Preserve parseGoTestAll, safeShellRune, validImportPath, goIgnoredDir, boundedBuffer, goCapture and their supporting types/flags unchanged.
2. Modify `internal/validation/validator.go`: remove Preliminary, Packages, FallbackReason and associated comments; simplify passed/failed report branches and timing outcome copy. Modify `build_cache.go`, `repair.go`, `internal/cli/validate.go`, and `work_validation.go` to remove only those field-dependent guards/branches. The resulting decisions must equal the old decisions with all three fields at zero values.
3. Modify `internal/validation/go_fastpass_test.go`: delete only TestGoFastPassReverseDependencies, TestFastPassFits, and TestParseGoListRejectsUnsafeMetadata; remove field assertions/imports made invalid. Keep every configured-check integration, progress, cancellation, timeout, JSON capture and parser test and all shared fixtures/helpers. Retain existing names to avoid needless caller churn. Update obsolete explanatory comments to describe current full-check behavior.
4. Modify `internal/validation/go_test_cache_test.go` to remove deleted-field assertions while retaining cache/failure checks. Modify `build_cache_test.go:753` to remove synthetic preliminary/abandoned records and preserve failed-run rejection and valid duration history coverage. Modify `internal/cli/work_progress_test.go:305` to replace the impossible preliminary fixture with ordinary pass/fail outcomes, preserving assertions for failure details and ordinary rendered text. Preserve the generic progress-printer test unchanged: a check name containing "changed packages" is just arbitrary input text.
5. Rename the CLI regression file as authorized below. Rename TestGoFastPassEntryPoints to TestConfiguredRequiredCheckEntryPoints; remove fake package-metadata handling and obsolete fast/preliminary expectations. Assert exactly one all-package test invocation per entry point (allow coordinator preparation commands separately); retain the observed `test -json ./...` capture behavior and issue setup/approval/acceptance fixtures. No scheduler or production command change.
6. Run TEST_PLAN.md checks, inspect the diff for output compatibility, and record evidence. No protected policy, harness, workflow, or documentation changes.

- Rename internal/cli/go_fastpass_test.go to internal/cli/required_checks_test.go

## HANDOFF

This handoff is evidence to verify against approved inputs, not gate or validation authority.

- Entry points: CheckRunOutcome (`validator.go:72`), Validate record closure (`validator.go:414`), timing copy (`validator.go:537`), recordRequiredDurations (`build_cache.go:254`), repair outcome loop (`repair.go:198`), writeValidationChecks (`internal/cli/validate.go:230`), writeWorkValidationFailure (`internal/cli/work_validation.go:23`), selection helpers (`go_fastpass.go:78,98,113,172`). Paths without a prefix here are under internal/validation/.
- Existing tests/fixtures: go_fastpass_test.go integration tests and goModuleFixture/setupGoFastPassRepo; TestRequiredCheckDurationHistoryStorage (`build_cache_test.go:734`); go_test_cache_test.go; repair_test.go; validator_test.go; CLI entrypoint regression (`internal/cli/go_fastpass_test.go:16`) and renderer fixture (`internal/cli/work_progress_test.go:305`). Preserve shared fixture names/call sites.
- Exact focused commands: `go build ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/validation`; `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/cli -run '^(TestConfiguredRequiredCheckEntryPoints|TestValidationChecksShowChangedPackagePass)$' -count=1`; symbol/format checks in TEST_PLAN.md. Run CLI tests as a package, not a single file, because they depend on package fixtures.
- Checked assumptions: recursive source search confirms only tests construct nonzero removed fields; live helper callers and shared fixture consumers were searched; rename destination absent in supplied snapshot; no docs/template references found. Approved-base identity needs developer confirmation because snapshot Git metadata is absent.
- Reopen if production writes are discovered, a removed helper has live callers, ordinary output changes, rename destination exists at base, or required-check execution must change. Do not widen to cache/repair redesign or harness changes.
- **What this change breaks**: dead-selector unit tests are deliberately deleted; outcome assertions in go_fastpass_test.go and go_test_cache_test.go lose only removed fields; duration-history synthetic obsolete cases in build_cache_test.go are removed while meaningful cases remain; CLI preliminary rendering fixture becomes ordinary pass/fail coverage; CLI old file/test name is renamed with callers selected by the new name. repair_test.go and validator_test.go shared fixture users, parser/JSON capture coverage, generic progress names, docs, templates and production scheduling remain unchanged. The global required CLI package check discovers the renamed file automatically. No complete file deletion is authorized.

# Test plan: ISSUE-520

## Acceptance coverage

| Criterion | Cases and concrete verification | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1: build/vet and removal | `go build ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `grep -RnE 'Preliminary|FallbackReason|fastPassFits|affectedPackages|parseGoList' internal/` must produce no matches (exit 1, not a search error). Inspect that CheckRunOutcome.Packages, goPackage and maxFastPass constants are gone; do not remove unrelated Packages fields. | developer |
| 2: configured checks at all entry points | `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/validation`; `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/cli -run '^(TestConfiguredRequiredCheckEntryPoints|TestValidationChecksShowChangedPackagePass)$' -count=1`. Retain validation integration cases for full success, unrelated failure, dirty edits, module/docs changes, CI, non-Go checks, progress, timeout and cancellation; renamed CLI test covers issue work, issue validate, issue submit and rejects extra selected-package test calls. | developer |
| Constraint: ordinary report/JSON unchanged | Retain TestGoJSONCaptureBoundary, TestParseGoTestAll, timing JSON round-trip and full-check report/event assertions in go_fastpass_test.go; cache and repair tests remain in package run. Adapt renderer fixture to ordinary PASS/FAIL including failing tests/output tail. Independently compare simplified conditions to old conditions with removed fields at zero; confirm their former omitempty fields never serialized in ordinary runs and timing metadata remains equivalent. | developer tests; tester independent review |

## Developer checks and evidence

Run the commands above after removal; format touched Go files and check `gofmt -l` on those files returns no paths. The required whole-tree vet covers changed-package static diagnostics. Do not add new tests mirroring field deletion; preserve substantive integration assertions. Do not discard shared fixtures along with obsolete unit tests.

Record command, exit status, duration, relevant output and source identity in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md` (or the workflow's implementation artifact). Include candidate commit/tree when available and a digest of the diff if uncommitted, so later roles can establish applicability. Distinguish environment failures from code failures; no network or credential requests. Planned focused commands are each expected to finish within five minutes; timeouts are bounds, not measured timings.

## Tester independent review

Map each criterion to the final diff and developer evidence. Independently inspect all removed readers, preserved helpers, CLI invocation filtering and ordinary report/JSON compatibility. Confirm deleted unit tests cover only deleted selection functions, while failure, repair, cache, cancellation and entrypoint coverage survives. Check the authorized rename and absence of protected-file changes. Reuse passing developer commands when the tested source identity applies. Repeat a focused command only for relevant later source changes, observed failure, missing evidence, or an unresolved coverage concern; retain targeted tests and format/static diagnostics when needed. Record acceptance disposition and reused evidence/source identity in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md` or the tester workflow artifact. Agent observations are advisory and cannot satisfy claim-bound validation/publication.

## Coordinator reference policy and long checks

The coordinator runs the complete approved-base required policy once after roles finish, using the compiled SYSTEM_PROMPT.md policy. This is not a developer/tester checklist. Only the coordinator owns claim-bound validation and publication.

| Check/command | Sole owner | Expected duration | Evidence and reuse |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Complete trusted-base required policy, including `go test -timeout=30m -parallel=8 ./internal/cli`, core regressions and configured security suites | coordinator | 10–40 minutes total; CLI suite may exceed five minutes | Coordinator validation artifacts tied to final candidate tree, approved base/policy and claim. Submission/CI reviewers reuse applicable result; agents do not rerun the entire policy. |

If any focused check unexpectedly exceeds five minutes, retain its single developer owner, record actual duration and source identity in implementation evidence, and have tester reuse it unless the repeat conditions above apply. No planner execution results are claimed; this phase inspected source only.

VERDICT: APPROVED

# Plan review: ISSUE-520

REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md holds only the prior design/test-plan text and no earlier review findings, so there are no IDs to carry forward. PLAN.md and TEST_PLAN.md match that evidence.

## Audit

| Item | Result | Evidence checked |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Objective: delete the fields, helpers, reader branches and their tests | Covered | `validator.go:85-91` (fields), `go_fastpass.go:17-21,78-85,97-150,168-221` (helpers). The readers are at `validator.go:415,426,537`, `build_cache.go:259,269`, `repair.go:199`, `cli/validate.go:240` and `cli/work_validation.go:31`. A grep found no other references; all nonzero writers are in tests (`work_progress_test.go:310,312`, `build_cache_test.go:753`). |
| Out-of-scope symbols kept | Covered | Step 1 keeps parseGoTestAll, validImportPath, goIgnoredDir, boundedBuffer and goCapture. `goCapture` is still called from `validator.go:818`. |
| Constraint: no behaviour change | Covered | Every simplified condition (for example `Passed && !Preliminary` becoming `Passed`, and dropping the SKIP and SKIPPED branches) gives the same result when the removed fields are zero. The fields were `omitempty`, so ordinary JSON output does not change. The tester independently compares the old and new conditions. |
| AC1: build, vet and grep | Covered | The test plan runs `go build`, `go vet` and the exact grep, which must exit 1. Every comment that names the symbols is deleted along with its symbol, so the grep can come back clean. |
| AC2: configured-check tests pass | Covered | The test plan runs `go test ./internal/validation` and the renamed CLI test, `TestConfiguredRequiredCheckEntryPoints`, for issue work, validate and submit. I ran the current `TestGoFastPassEntryPoints` and `TestValidationChecksShowChangedPackagePass` here and both passed (`ok internal/cli 0.478s`). |
| Rename | Covered | `internal/cli/required_checks_test.go` does not exist yet. The rename falls inside AC2's "renamed internal/cli test file". |
| Protected paths | Covered | No protected files are touched. |
| Who runs which check, and how long | Covered | Each focused command has one owner and should take under 5 minutes. The tester reuses the developer's results unless the source changed. The full CLI suite is left to the coordinator only. |
| Scope | OK | No changes to scheduling, cache, repair, docs or the harness. |

## Notes (non-blocking)

- Once the helpers are gone, `goTestCommand.buildFlags` (`go_fastpass.go:37,67`) is no longer used by production code; only `go_fastpass_test.go:473` reads it. The plan keeps it as a "supporting flag", which fits the WorkUnit's scope. Removing it could be a follow-up WorkUnit.
- In the renamed CLI test, keep the assertion that each entry point makes "exactly one all-package test invocation" no stricter than what production actually runs. If other `go` invocations show up, record them rather than changing how the commands run.
